title: The Machine Learning + Research Paper Reading + Critical Analysis + Research Gap Identification Handbook: A Bilingual (English–Bangla) Guide
description: A bilingual (English–Bangla) study and reference handbook for students and early-career researchers. It covers machine learning foundations, reading research papers, critical analysis, research gap identification, turning a verified gap into a testable research question, research in the age of large language models, and the path from a research proposal to a published paper. Final Edition, 2026, 199 pages, with full Typst source.
